children.title: Which cities currently have branches?
children.text: We are actively serving across Hyderabad — Kukatpally, Madhapur, Miyapur, Gachibowli, Dilsukhnagar, LB Nagar and more — with new outlets opening in Vijayawada, Bangalore and Chennai soon.

children.title: How can I locate my nearest branch?
children.text: Use the search bar above or scroll to the map section. Enter your city or area and we’ll show you the closest Patnam Pakodi outlet with live directions.

children.title: Do all branches have the same menu?
children.text: Yes. Every branch follows the same standardized menu and SOP — so the Guntur Pachi Mirchi Pakodi you love in Kukatpally tastes identical in LB Nagar.

children.title: Can I order online?
children.text: Absolutely. All branches are live on Swiggy and Zomato, and you can also call the branch directly for pickup orders.

children.title: How do I apply for a franchise?
children.text: Tap the ‘Apply for Franchise’ button, fill in the short form, and our franchise team will call you within 24 hours to walk you through the display, cart, cabin and premium models.

sections.title: Cart and Cabin: kitchen equipment
sections.body: An electric fryer (2 x 6 litres), LED board, food-grade chopping board, knife, oil drainer bowl, digital weighing machine, four marination powder boxes, four measuring spoons, four measuring cups, four stainless-steel mixing bowls, drinking-water setup with tap and table, drinking glasses, cleaning cloths, four masala topping containers and ten sauce bottles.

sections.title: Cart and Cabin: welcome and branding kit
sections.body: Tissue papers, toothpicks, disposable forks, three menu cards, hand gloves, head caps, dustbin, a 5 ft by 3 ft brand standing board, two branded T-shirts and two branded caps.

sections.title: Cabin: additional equipment
sections.body: Chaat pan, Chinese starter pan, SS clipper, oven and a 6 litre cooling box. The package also includes 20 kg masala, branded packing boxes and branded plates.

sections.title: Shop Setup: food, equipment and branding
sections.body: Waffle machines, burger and sandwich setups, oven, deep freezer, chaat pan, Chinese starter pan, fryer, preparation equipment and cooling box. Branding includes a 5 ft by 3 ft LED brand board, a 5 ft by 3 ft standing brand board and three LED menu boards. The brochure includes the full equipment and welcome-kit list.

sections.title: Brand-Only: starter stock and branding
sections.body: 20 kg masala, 150 branded packing boxes and 300 branded plates, plus kitchen items, LED boards and menu boards. Physical branding includes packing boxes, plates, T-shirts, caps, bottles and standing boards. Customized prices may change.
